construct: Type I collagen is a heterotrimer of two alpha-1(I) and one alpha-2(I) chains with a Gly-X-Y repeating triple-helical region. Pathogenic variants can reduce type I collagen quantity or disrupt helix structure, producing bone fragility and characteristic extraskeletal connective-tissue manifestations.
